title: Silk Coils
description: Thirty rotation, lateral, and pull intervals from the canonical Fable W2 routine.

intervals.coachNote: March easily while rolling the shoulders smoothly; no bounce.
Move through cat-cow into a comfortable child reach; do not force the overhead position.
regressions: Shorten the reach or keep the hips higher if the shoulder or hip feels restricted.

intervals.coachNote: Switch actively through a comfortable range; do not force the right-hip end range.
regressions: Use hand support or a smaller range if the hip catches or pinches.

intervals.coachNote: Reach side to side symmetrically without collapsing into the low back.
Slide the arms only through a comfortable range; keep the ribs controlled.
regressions: Use a smaller range or stop before shoulder apprehension.

intervals.coachNote: Prepare the ankles with pumps and heel-to-toe rocks; this is not a calf-raise station.
Hold one dumbbell at the chest and use a 1.5-rep or paused squat with heels down.
regressions: Use a lighter load or a smaller range while keeping the heels down.

intervals.coachNote: Use a moderate range with the whole foot planted and the knee tracking over the foot.
regressions: Shorten the range or use support rather than forcing the great toe.

intervals.coachNote: Use a moderate range with the whole foot planted and the knee tracking over the foot.
regressions: Shorten the range or use support rather than forcing the great toe.

intervals.coachNote: Keep the rear foot flat and place about 20% of the load through it.
regressions: Use a lighter load, a shorter range, or more rear-foot support.

intervals.coachNote: Keep the rear foot flat and place about 20% of the load through it.
regressions: Use a lighter load, a shorter range, or more rear-foot support.

intervals.coachNote: Support the forearm on the thigh, pull with a quiet shoulder, and squeeze for one second.
regressions: Use a lighter dumbbell or more support if the trunk rotates.

intervals.coachNote: Support the forearm on the thigh, pull with a quiet shoulder, and squeeze for one second.
regressions: Use a lighter dumbbell or more support if the trunk rotates.

intervals.coachNote: Use a slow push-up with a neutral shoulder and controlled trunk.
regressions: Use knees-down or hands-elevated; fists do not unload the first MTP.

intervals.coachNote: Press with a neutral grip and stop before shoulder apprehension; keep the ribs stacked.
regressions: Use a lighter dumbbell or a shorter pain-free press range.

intervals.coachNote: Press with a neutral grip and stop before shoulder apprehension; keep the ribs stacked.
regressions: Use a lighter dumbbell or a shorter pain-free press range.

intervals.coachNote: Rotate through the hips and upper trunk; finish around chest or eye height rather than overhead.
regressions: Use a lighter load and a smaller rotation if the back or shoulder complains.

intervals.coachNote: Rotate through the hips and upper trunk; finish around chest or eye height rather than overhead.
regressions: Use a lighter load and a smaller rotation if the back or shoulder complains.

intervals.coachNote: Hold one dumbbell at the chest, press it away slowly, switch hands at 20 seconds, and keep the trunk still.
regressions: Use a lighter load or a shorter press while keeping the ribs down.

intervals.coachNote: Load the stance leg and press the inside knee into the wall for about 2 × 15 seconds while keeping the pelvis level.
regressions: Reduce wall pressure or shorten the holds if lateral-hip pain appears.

intervals.coachNote: Load the stance leg and press the inside knee into the wall for about 2 × 15 seconds while keeping the pelvis level.
regressions: Reduce wall pressure or shorten the holds if lateral-hip pain appears.

intervals.coachNote: Chamber slowly with the wall available; avoid a forceful pivot or snap.
regressions: Use wall support and reduce the knee height or range.

intervals.coachNote: Chamber slowly with the wall available; avoid a forceful pivot or snap.
regressions: Use wall support and reduce the knee height or range.

intervals.tempo: 3 s up / 1 s pause / 3 s down
intervals.coachNote: Place a dumbbell on the thigh and load the soleus at 3 seconds up / 1 second hold / 3 seconds down.
regressions: Use less load or bilateral work; keep pain 0–3/10 and below the 5/10 ceiling.

intervals.tempo: 3 s up / 1 s pause / 3 s down
intervals.coachNote: Place a dumbbell on the thigh and load the soleus at 3 seconds up / 1 second hold / 3 seconds down.
regressions: Use less load or bilateral work; keep pain 0–3/10 and below the 5/10 ceiling.

intervals.coachNote: Lean into a wall and lift the toes with a two-second rise and three-second lower.
regressions: Use a smaller range or more wall support if the shins fatigue early.

intervals.coachNote: Use a goblet or front-rack hold, lift the knees without bouncing, and keep the trunk tall.
regressions: Use a lighter dumbbell or lower the knee height while staying steady.

intervals.coachNote: Use combinations with both feet planted; do not bounce or pivot forcefully.
regressions: Slow the combinations or reduce the range while keeping the feet planted.

intervals.coachNote: Land flat-footed, find balance, and gently lift the arch without gripping the toes.
regressions: Use a wall or shorten the step; keep the landing flat and quiet.

intervals.coachNote: Use support for a gentle side reach, switch at 20 seconds, and breathe continuously.
regressions: Keep both feet planted and reduce the reach if balance is uncertain.
